user.title: Nest Local
user.description: Home Assistant will act as the cloud server for Nest thermostats running the NoLongerEvil firmware. After setup, a notification shows the exact address to enter as cloudregisterurl on the thermostat.

data_description.host: IPv4 address of this Home Assistant on your network. The thermostat cannot resolve names like homeassistant.local.
data_description.port: TCP port the thermostat connects to. Choose another one if the NoLongerEvil app is still running on 9543.

reconfigure.title: Nest Local
reconfigure.description: If you change the address or port, update cloudregisterurl on the thermostat and reboot it.

data_description.host: IPv4 address of this Home Assistant on your network.
data_description.port: TCP port the thermostat connects to.

error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address such as 192.168.1.10.
error.port_in_use: This port is already in use on Home Assistant.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Nest Local is already set up. One server handles all thermostats.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Settings saved. Update cloudregisterurl on the thermostat if the address changed.

init.title: Nest Local options
init.description: To heat on a weekly plan, create a Schedule helper (Settings → Devices & services → Helpers → Create helper → Schedule) and mark the heating periods of each day. Choose it below: the plan is stored on the thermostat, which then follows it even without Home Assistant.

data.weather_proxy: Pass weather requests to Nest's weather service

data_description.weather_proxy: Lets the thermostat show the outdoor temperature. Uses weather.nest.com.
data_description.hot_water_boost_minutes: Used by the hot water boost switch.
data_description.schedule_entity: A Schedule helper. Its plan replaces the schedule of every thermostat connected to this integration: changes made on a thermostat are overwritten and Auto-Schedule is turned off. Leave empty to keep the thermostats' own schedules.
data_description.heat_temperature: Used for every period that has no temperature of its own (additional data: temperature, in °C).
data_description.setback_temperature: Kept between the periods, for example at night.

error.heat_not_above_setback: The temperature in the heating periods must be higher than outside them.

cannot_heat.message: Thermostat {serial} is not wired for heating.

cannot_cool.message: Thermostat {serial} is not wired for cooling.

cannot_heat_cool.message: Thermostat {serial} needs both heating and cooling for heat/cool mode.

no_fan.message: Thermostat {serial} does not control a fan.

no_hot_water.message: Thermostat {serial} does not control hot water.

no_schedule.message: Thermostat {serial} has not sent its weekly schedule yet. It sends it after a restart.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns the weekly schedule stored on the thermostat.
